item.description:
CC Pilot 0.2.0: new profiles get their own settings instead of sharing the default profile's.
- **Settings are now kept per profile.** When you add a profile (`ccp add`, or adding one in the app), the default profile's `~/.claude/settings.json` is copied once as its starting settings. After that, changing a setting in one profile, for example with `/model` or `/advisor`, affects only that profile. Profiles on different subscription tiers can now use different models and advisors. - **Plugins are still shared, but enabling them isn't.** Whether a plugin is enabled is part of each profile's settings, so a plugin you enable later in one profile has to be enabled with `/plugin` in the others. - **Profiles created with 0.1.0 are unchanged** and still share settings with the default profile. To give one its own settings:
```sh rm ~/.claude-profiles/<name>/settings.json && cp ~/.claude/settings.json ~/.claude-profiles/<name>/settings.json ```
- To have a new profile share settings like before:
```sh rm ~/.claude-profiles/<name>/settings.json && ln -s ~/.claude/settings.json ~/.claude-profiles/<name>/settings.json ```
The app updates `ccp` in `~/.cc-pilot/` the next time it starts. If you use only the command line tool without the app, copy the new `shell/` directory to `~/.cc-pilot/` again.
---
CC Pilot 0.2.0：新建的账号使用自己的一份设置，不再与默认账号共用。
- **设置改为每个账号各一份**。新建账号时（`ccp add`，或在 App 里添加账号），把默认账号的 `~/.claude/settings.json` 复制一次作为初始设置，之后在某个账号里修改设置（比如执行 `/model`、`/advisor`）只影响这个账号。不同订阅等级的账号可以用不同的模型和 advisor 了。 - **插件仍然共用，但"是否启用"各管各的**。插件的启用状态记在各账号的设置里，之后在一个账号里启用的插件，在其他账号里需要用 `/plugin` 再启用一次。 - **0.1.0 建立的账号保持不变**，仍与默认账号共用设置。想让某个已有账号使用自己的设置：
```sh rm ~/.claude-profiles/<名字>/settings.json && cp ~/.claude/settings.json ~/.claude-profiles/<名字>/settings.json ```
- 想让新账号像以前一样共用设置：
```sh rm ~/.claude-profiles/<名字>/settings.json && ln -s ~/.claude/settings.json ~/.claude-profiles/<名字>/settings.json ```
App 下次启动时会自动更新 `~/.cc-pilot/` 里的 `ccp`。只用命令行、没装 App 的话，把新版的 `shell/` 目录重新复制为 `~/.cc-pilot/`。
